articles.summary: Franklin Financial Services Corporation (the Corporation) (NASDAQ: FRAF), the bank holding company of FM Trust (the Bank) headquartered in Chambersburg, PA, reported its fourth quarter 2025 and year-to-date 2025 results. articles.title: Franklin Financial Reports 2025 Q4 and Year-to-Date Results; Declares Dividend
